changes.comment: Align agents[].config and unattended approval posture with codex and antigravity: add optional non-empty effort (--effort ahead of extra_args), reject blank model/effort strings, remove permission_mode and turn_timeout_ms from config (tolerated and ignored under R21; stream-inactivity timeout stays an internal 600s constant), always launch with --dangerously-skip-permissions, reject unexpected can_use_tool callbacks fail-fast instead of auto-allowing, and drop removed config constants from public exports.
